concerns.text: Plan element T090 (`code/analysis/collinearity_checker.py` + `tests/unit/test_collinearity_checker.py`, mapped to SC-004 and the 'Assumption (Collinearity)' row) has no owning task. V06 only says 'logistic regression with VIF check' inside power_curve work; the plan specifies a distinct module and unit test that no task creates or verifies. Add a task (or fold explicitly into T105 with the module path and test named).

T104 requires the convergence monitor to flag iterations with 'tolerance < 1e-4', but T101's convergence-log record schema is [iteration_id, sample_size, converged, max_iterations, error_message] — no tolerance field is ever produced by any task. Either T101 must write a tolerance field or T104 must drop that criterion; as written the monitor reads a field no task generates.

T103's verification asserts split_half_results.json 'contains a binary replication status', but T102 defines that file's schema as [{sample_size, kernel, replication_rate, iterations}] — aggregated rates, not per-iteration binary outcomes. The T103 check cannot be satisfied by the artifact T102 produces; align the assertion with T102's schema (e.g., replication_rate ∈ [0,1]) or have T102 also emit per-iteration records.

All V01–V09 items are rendered as unchecked boxes '- [ ]' despite the header stating they are 'verified complete' and 'preserve; do not redo'. An implementer following checkbox state will redo preserved work. Mark them '- [x]' or restructure as a non-checklist block.
